gen1_notes.memory_31: Signup simplification is validated for SMB: signups increased 15%, activation rose 9%, and qualified revenue grew 4%, with a small 1% decline in 30-day retention. Keep this scoped to SMB; we did not replicate the result in other segments.
gen1_notes.memory_44: The sales-assisted CTA is a confirmed enterprise play. Although signup fell 12%, qualified leads increased 24% and qualified revenue increased 18%, with no 30-day retention change. Optimize against lead and revenue quality rather than raw signup volume for this segment.
gen1_notes.memory_57: Referral incentives worked for established accounts, producing 21% more referral starts, 7% more qualified revenue, and a 2% lift in 30-day retention. The effect is concentrated in accounts older than six months, so target that population rather than applying broadly.
gen1_notes.memory_73: The 40% targeted discount drove short-term acquisition in price-sensitive SMBs: signup increased 31% and qualified revenue increased 18%. However, 30-day retention fell 12%, and the acquired cohort did not make it through the first renewal cycle. Do not treat targeted discounting as a sustainable-growth lever.
gen1_notes.memory_86: Shortening the onboarding flow is confirmed: completion increased 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%. This is a durable onboarding improvement worth carrying forward.
gen1_notes.memory_91: In-product activation messaging is confirmed as a modest but positive activation lever. Week-one engagement increased 11%, activation rose 6%, and 30-day retention improved 1%. Continue using it to support early-product engagement.

gen2_lessons.memory_44: For enterprise, a sales-assisted CTA is a validated quality-over-volume play: signups fell 12%, but qualified leads rose 24% and qualified revenue rose 18%, with no change in 30-day retention. gen2_lessons.memory_57: Referral incentives are effective for established accounts, particularly those older than six months: referral starts increased 21%, qualified revenue increased 7%, and 30-day retention increased 2%.
